# opnsense_dnsmasq_tag (Data Source)

Configure tag for dnsmasq.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_dnsmasq_tag" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `tag` (String) An alphanumeric label which marks a network so that DHCP options may be specified on a per-network basis.
